blocks.zh: Section 2: Physical Tests & Container Evaluation | 物理試驗與容器評估
blocks.en: Section 2: Physical Tests & Container Evaluation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解可萃取砷（extractable arsenic）測試的適用對象、取樣方法與限度要求（0.1 µg/g）。
blocks.en: Understand the scope, sampling method and limit requirement (0.1 µg/g) of the extractable arsenic test.

blocks.zh: 掌握有色玻璃容器光譜透射率（spectral transmission）測試的儀器設備、樣品製備與測量方法。
blocks.en: Master the equipment, sample preparation and measurement method for spectral transmission testing of colored glass containers.

blocks.zh: 解讀 Table 7 中不同容量與密封方式的有色玻璃容器光譜透射率限度，理解其保護藥品的科學依據。
blocks.en: Interpret the spectral transmission limits in Table 7 for colored glass containers of different capacities and closure types, and understand the scientific basis of their protection of the drug product.

blocks.zh: 說明非注射劑用有色玻璃容器的透射率統一限度（10%）與注射劑用容器限度的差異。
blocks.en: Explain the difference between the single transmission limit (10%) for colored glass containers for non-parenteral products and the limits for parenteral containers.

blocks.zh: 了解整章測試架構的連貫性：從玻璃分類（化學耐性）到物理功能性（防光保護）的完整評估框架。
blocks.en: Understand the coherence of the test structure of the whole chapter: a complete evaluation framework from glass classification (chemical resistance) to physical functionality (light protection).

blocks.zh: 2.1 Impurities — Extractable Arsenic | 雜質：可萃取砷
blocks.en: 2.1 Impurities — Extractable Arsenic

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何只測砷（Arsenic）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Only Arsenic Is Tested

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器的重金屬雜質關注清單中，砷（As）被 USP 〈660〉 單獨列出，主要理由：
blocks.en: Among the heavy-metal impurities of concern for glass containers, arsenic (As) is singled out by USP <660>, mainly for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 歷史原因：傳統玻璃製造工藝（特別是舊式蘇打石灰矽玻璃）曾使用含砷化合物作為澄清劑（fining agent），使玻璃更均勻透明。現代製程雖已大幅減少，但殘留風險仍存在。
blocks.en: Historical reasons: Traditional glass manufacturing (especially older soda-lime silica glass) used arsenic compounds as fining agents to make the glass more homogeneous and clear. Modern processes have greatly reduced this, but a residual risk remains.

blocks.zh: 毒性：砷是確認的人類致癌物（IARC Group 1），即使微量也有累積毒性，對注射劑患者而言是不可接受的風險。
blocks.en: Toxicity: Arsenic is a confirmed human carcinogen (IARC Group 1) with cumulative toxicity even at trace levels, an unacceptable risk for patients receiving injectables.

blocks.zh: 釋出途徑：砷溶於水溶液的能力（特別在鹼性環境下），使其可從玻璃內表面萃取進入藥品——恰好就是 Surface Glass Test 的萃取液。
blocks.en: Release pathway: The ability of arsenic to dissolve in aqueous solution (especially under alkaline conditions) allows it to be extracted from the glass inner surface into the drug product, which is exactly the extract of the Surface Glass Test.

blocks.zh: 0.1 µg/g 限度以「萃取液重量（g）」而非體積（mL）計算，這是因為不同密度溶液的萃取液質量不同，以重量為基準更準確。
blocks.en: The 0.1 µg/g limit is calculated on the "weight of extract (g)" rather than volume (mL), because the mass of extract differs for solutions of different density, so a weight basis is more accurate.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 砷測試就像飲用水的重金屬檢測——自來水管（玻璃容器）老化後，鉛或砷可能溶入水中。對於注射藥品，這個「水管」的品質要求比自來水管更嚴格，因為藥品直接進入血液，沒有腸胃道的過濾保護。0.1 µg/g 的限度反映了在無菌注射劑使用情境下的最嚴格安全標準。
blocks.en: The arsenic test is like testing drinking water for heavy metals: when a water pipe (glass container) ages, lead or arsenic may dissolve into the water. For injectable drug products the quality requirement for this "pipe" is stricter than for a tap-water pipe, because the drug goes directly into the bloodstream without the filtering protection of the gastrointestinal tract. The 0.1 µg/g limit reflects the strictest safety standard for sterile injectable use.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 測試樣品來源：直接使用 Surface Glass Test 的萃取液（water from the Surface Glass Test），而非另行製備。這意味著砷測試是 Surface Glass Test 的「附加測試」，不需要額外的高壓釜程序，非常節省時間與資源。
blocks.en: Source of test sample: The extract from the Surface Glass Test (water from the Surface Glass Test) is used directly rather than prepared separately. This makes the arsenic test an "add-on test" to the Surface Glass Test with no additional autoclave procedure, saving a great deal of time and resources.

blocks.zh: 適用對象：僅限 Type I 或 Type II 水溶液注射劑容器。Type III 容器由於不適用於注射劑，不需要此測試。非注射劑用途的 Type I/II 容器也不強制要求。
blocks.en: Applicability: Limited to Type I or Type II containers for aqueous injectable products. Type III containers are not intended for injectables and do not need this test. Type I/II containers for non-parenteral use are also not required to be tested.

blocks.zh: 引用章節 〈211〉：USP 〈211〉 Arsenic 是通則（General Test）中的砷測定法，〈660〉 直接引用其方法，體現 USP 體系的模組化設計——專用測試方法不重複撰寫，而是交叉引用。
blocks.en: Reference to chapter <211>: USP <211> Arsenic is the General Test for arsenic determination, and <660> cites its method directly, reflecting the modular design of the USP system: a dedicated test method is not rewritten but cross-referenced.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 在進行玻璃容器進料品管時，如果批次 CoA 中包含 Surface Glass Test 數據但未明確列出砷測試結果，QC 應主動要求供應商補充。特別是對於含有高鹼性緩衝液（pH > 7）的大分子生物製劑（mAb、蛋白質），砷從玻璃釋出的速率較高，是容器相容性研究（CCS study）中的必要測試項目。ICH Q3E（Container Closure System Extractables）文件中也強調重金屬作為可萃取物的評估義務。
blocks.en: When a CDMO performs incoming quality control on glass containers, if the batch CoA includes Surface Glass Test data but does not explicitly list an arsenic result, QC should proactively ask the supplier to supplement it. Especially for large-molecule biologics (mAbs, proteins) in highly alkaline buffers (pH > 7), arsenic is released from glass at a higher rate, making this a necessary test item in container compatibility studies (CCS studies). The ICH Q3E document (Container Closure System Extractables) also stresses the obligation to evaluate heavy metals as extractables.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼砷限度以 µg/g（重量/重量）而非 µg/mL（重量/體積）表示？在實際計算中，兩者有什麼差異？
blocks.en: Why is the arsenic limit expressed in µg/g (weight/weight) rather than µg/mL (weight/volume)? What is the difference between the two in actual calculation?

blocks.zh: 若一批 Type II 玻璃容器的 Surface Glass Test 萃取液中砷測試結果為 0.08 µg/g，是否符合規格？若結果為 0.12 µg/g，應採取哪些行動？
blocks.en: If the arsenic result in the Surface Glass Test extract of a batch of Type II glass containers is 0.08 µg/g, does it meet the specification? If the result is 0.12 µg/g, what actions should be taken?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Type III 玻璃容器不需要進行砷測試，而不是設定更寬鬆的限度？
blocks.en: Why do Type III glass containers not need the arsenic test, instead of being given a more lenient limit?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Functionality — Spectral Transmission for Colored Glass Containers | 功能性：有色玻璃容器光譜透射率
blocks.en: 2.2 Functionality — Spectral Transmission for Colored Glass Containers

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何需要光譜透射率測試
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Spectral Transmission Testing Is Needed

blocks.zh: 許多藥物對紫外線（UV）敏感，特別是在 290–450 nm（UV-A 至近可見光）範圍內：
blocks.en: Many drugs are sensitive to ultraviolet (UV) light, especially in the range of 290–450 nm (UV-A to near-visible light):

blocks.zh: 維生素（如核黃素、葉酸）：UV 照射導致降解。
blocks.en: Vitamins (such as riboflavin and folic acid): UV exposure causes degradation.

blocks.zh: 蛋白質生物製劑：光照可誘發聚集（aggregation）與氧化。
blocks.en: Protein biologics: light can induce aggregation and oxidation.

blocks.zh: 某些抗生素、抗腫瘤藥物：光化學降解產生有毒副產品。
blocks.en: Certain antibiotics and antineoplastic drugs: photochemical degradation produces toxic by-products.

blocks.zh: 有色玻璃（amber glass，琥珀色）透過添加氧化鐵（Fe₂O₃）、氧化錳（MnO₂）等金屬氧化物呈現棕/琥珀色，可吸收 UV 光，但其保護效果因容器壁厚、顏色深淺而異，因此需要量化測試——這就是光譜透射率測試的目的。
blocks.en: Colored glass (amber glass) gets its brown/amber color from added metal oxides such as iron oxide (Fe₂O₃) and manganese oxide (MnO₂), and can absorb UV light. However, its protective effect varies with container wall thickness and depth of color, so quantitative testing is required, which is the purpose of the spectral transmission test.

blocks.zh: 光譜透射率測試就像太陽眼鏡的 UV 防護測試：不是所有深色鏡片都能有效擋 UV——顏色深淺是視覺判斷，但真正的防護能力需要儀器測量（透射率≤10%）。藥廠的琥珀色玻璃瓶就是藥品的「太陽眼鏡」，USP 〈660〉 確保這副眼鏡真的能擋住傷害藥品的「UV 光線」。
blocks.en: Spectral transmission testing is like UV-protection testing of sunglasses: not every dark lens blocks UV effectively. Depth of color is a visual judgment, but real protective ability needs instrument measurement (transmission ≤10%). A pharmaceutical amber glass vial is the drug's "sunglasses", and USP <660> ensures that these sunglasses really do block the "UV rays" that damage the drug.

blocks.zh: 積分球（integrating sphere）的作用：曲面玻璃（容器壁切片）會散射光線，普通分光光度計無法完整收集所有透射光。積分球將散射光全部收集後送入探測器，確保測量結果代表「實際透射率」而非只有直射光分量。
blocks.en: The role of the integrating sphere: Curved glass (a section cut from the container wall) scatters light, and an ordinary spectrophotometer cannot collect all of the transmitted light. The integrating sphere collects all the scattered light and sends it to the detector, ensuring the measurement represents the "actual transmission" rather than only the directly transmitted component.

blocks.zh: Table 7 限度解讀邏輯
blocks.en: How to Read the Table 7 Limits

blocks.zh:
注射劑用有色玻璃容器透射率限度（Table 7）：

關鍵觀察：
1. 容器越大 → 允許透射率越低（限度更嚴）
   原因：大容器壁較厚，理論上應更有保護效果；
        若仍透射率高，說明玻璃品質不足。

2. 封口方式的差異：
   火焰封口（flame-sealed，安瓿）：限度較寬鬆
   蓋封容器（with closures，瓶/卡匣）：限度較嚴格

   原因：蓋封容器頸部壁厚通常較薄（≤安瓿火焰封口部位），
        光線可能從薄壁處透入，因此需更嚴格的整體控制。

非注射劑用：統一限度 ≤ 10%，不分容積與封口形式
（因為藥品有腸胃屏障，安全餘裕較大）
blocks.en:
Transmission limits for colored glass containers for parenteral products (Table 7):

Key observations:
1. The larger the container → the lower the permitted transmission (stricter limit)
   Reason: larger containers have thicker walls and should in theory protect better;
        if transmission is still high, the glass quality is insufficient.

2. Difference in closure method:
   Flame-sealed (ampoules): more lenient limit
   Containers with closures (vials/cartridges): stricter limit

   Reason: the neck wall of containers with closures is usually thinner (≤ the flame-sealed part of an ampoule),
        and light may penetrate through the thin wall, so tighter overall control is needed.

Non-parenteral: single limit ≤ 10%, regardless of volume and closure type
(because the gastrointestinal barrier gives the drug a larger safety margin)

blocks.zh: 測量範圍 290–450 nm：低於 290 nm 的 UV 在大氣層被臭氧層吸收，實際上不會到達藥品；450 nm 以上進入可見光範圍（藍光），對多數藥物無顯著光降解作用。290–450 nm 是最危險的「光化學活性窗口」。
blocks.en: Measurement range of 290–450 nm: UV below 290 nm is absorbed by the ozone layer in the atmosphere and does not actually reach the drug product; above 450 nm is the visible range (blue light), which has no significant photodegradation effect on most drugs. 290–450 nm is the most dangerous "photochemically active window".

blocks.zh: 「不超過 10% 在任何波長（at any wavelength）」：這是最嚴格的表述方式。測試時若在 320 nm 處透射率為 8%，但在 380 nm 處為 12%，則不合格，因為任一波長超過限度就判為失敗。不允許「平均值合格」的解釋。
blocks.en: "Not more than 10% at any wavelength": This is the strictest form of wording. If transmission is 8% at 320 nm but 12% at 380 nm, the container fails, because exceeding the limit at any one wavelength is a failure. An interpretation of "the average passes" is not allowed.

blocks.zh: 使用不透明外包裝豁免：透明玻璃容器若放入不透明外包裝（如紙盒），依 〈659〉 的「光保護容器」定義，可豁免光譜透射率測試要求。這在選材決策上給了 CDMO 一個替代路徑。
blocks.en: Exemption when an opaque outer package is used: A clear glass container placed in an opaque outer package (such as a carton) can be exempted from the spectral transmission test requirement under the definition of "light-resistant container" in <659>. This gives a CDMO an alternative path in material selection decisions.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 開發光敏性生物製劑（如 ADC 抗體藥物偶聯物）的 2 mL 注射劑時，選擇有色玻璃瓶（蓋封型）時，Table 7 要求透射率 ≤ 15%（2–5 mL，有蓋容器）。若供應商 CoA 上的測試結果為「在 350 nm 達到 18%」，則不符合規格，必須更換供應商或要求供應商改善配方（增加金屬氧化物含量）。
blocks.en: When a CDMO develops a 2 mL injectable for a light-sensitive biologic (such as an ADC, antibody-drug conjugate) and selects a colored glass vial (with closure), Table 7 requires transmission ≤ 15% (2–5 mL, container with closure). If the test result on the supplier CoA is "18% at 350 nm", it does not meet the specification, and the supplier must be changed or asked to improve the formulation (increasing the metal oxide content).

blocks.zh: 此外，在穩定性研究（ICH Q1B，光穩定性）中，使用不符合規格的琥珀色瓶可能導致光穩定性試驗失敗，進而影響上市申請（NDA/BLA）的時程——這是 CDMO 容器選材風險管理的真實場景。
blocks.en: In addition, in stability studies (ICH Q1B, photostability), using an amber vial that does not meet the specification may cause the photostability study to fail, which in turn affects the timeline of the marketing application (NDA/BLA). This is a real-life scenario in CDMO container material selection risk management.

blocks.zh: 為什麼光譜透射率測試需要使用「積分球（integrating sphere）」而非普通分光光度計的積分？這與玻璃容器的幾何形狀有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does spectral transmission testing need an "integrating sphere" rather than the standard integration of an ordinary spectrophotometer? How is this related to the geometry of glass containers?

blocks.zh: 一個 15 mL 的注射劑用琥珀色玻璃瓶（蓋封型），在 400 nm 測得透射率為 11%，在所有其他波長均低於 12%。依 Table 7，此容器是否合格？
blocks.en: A 15 mL amber glass vial for injectables (with closure) shows 11% transmission at 400 nm and below 12% at all other wavelengths. According to Table 7, is the container acceptable?

blocks.zh: 如果一個製藥公司決定使用透明玻璃瓶配不透明紙盒包裝光敏性藥品，這樣的設計在 GMP 體系中需要什麼樣的驗證（validation）或評估？
blocks.en: If a pharmaceutical company decides to use a clear glass vial with an opaque carton to package a light-sensitive drug, what validation or evaluation is needed for such a design within the GMP system?

blocks.zh: Table 7 中，火焰封口容器（安瓿）的限度為何比蓋封容器寬鬆？從容器設計的角度解釋這個差異的合理性。
blocks.en: Why is the limit for flame-sealed containers (ampoules) in Table 7 more lenient than for containers with closures? Explain from a container design perspective why this difference is reasonable.

blocks.zh: 2.3 Chapter Context & Cross-References | 章節背景與交叉引用
blocks.en: 2.3 Chapter Context & Cross-References

blocks.zh: 核心概念：USP 〈660〉 在整個 GMP 體系中的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Position of USP <660> in the Overall GMP System

blocks.zh: USP 〈660〉 是藥用玻璃容器的「基礎合規工具」。理解其與其他文件的關係非常重要：
blocks.en: USP <660> is the "basic compliance tool" for pharmaceutical glass containers. It is important to understand its relationship to other documents:

blocks.zh: 〈660〉 vs 〈1660〉：〈660〉 是強制性規格測試（compulsory testing）；〈1660〉 是指引性評估方法（informational/guidance），包含脫層（delamination）風險評估——後者對現代生物製劑的容器相容性研究尤為重要。
blocks.en: <660> vs <1660>: <660> is compulsory testing against specifications; <1660> is informational/guidance, covering delamination risk assessment, which is especially important for container compatibility studies of modern biologics.

blocks.zh: 〈660〉 vs ICH Q3E：ICH Q3E（可萃取物與浸出物指引）範疇更廣，涵蓋有機可萃取物；〈660〉 的化學測試主要針對無機鹼與重金屬。兩者互補。
blocks.en: <660> vs ICH Q3E: ICH Q3E (guideline on extractables and leachables) has a broader scope and covers organic extractables; the chemical tests in <660> mainly address inorganic alkali and heavy metals. The two are complementary.

blocks.zh: 〈660〉 vs FDA Container Guidance：FDA 的「Container Closure Systems for Packaging Human Drugs and Biologics」引導企業如何用 〈660〉 的數據支持 NDA/ANDA/BLA 申請。
blocks.en: <660> vs FDA Container Guidance: FDA's "Container Closure Systems for Packaging Human Drugs and Biologics" guides firms on how to use <660> data to support NDA/ANDA/BLA applications.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 玻璃測試的完整架構
blocks.en: Analogy — The Complete Structure of Glass Testing

blocks.zh: USP 〈660〉 的測試架構像一個三層篩選系統：第一層是「材料鑑定」（Glass Grains Test——你用的是什麼材料？）；第二層是「成品表面品質」（Surface Glass Test——你的容器實際接觸面怎麼樣？）；第三層是「功能性驗證」（Spectral Transmission——你的容器能保護藥品不受光線破壞嗎？）。砷測試則是「安全底線」——確認容器不會主動傷害患者。
blocks.en: The test structure of USP <660> is like a three-layer screening system: the first layer is "material identification" (Glass Grains Test: what material are you using?); the second is "finished product surface quality" (Surface Glass Test: what is the actual contact surface of your container like?); the third is "functional verification" (Spectral Transmission: can your container protect the drug from damaging light?). The arsenic test is the "safety baseline", confirming that the container will not actively harm the patient.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — IRA 修訂版本說明
blocks.en: Key Notes — About the IRA Revision

blocks.zh: 本章文字中反覆出現的「▲ (IRA 1-Oct-2023)」標記，代表 Interim Revision Announcement（臨時修訂公告），自 2023 年 10 月 1 日起正式生效。這些修訂主要是文字澄清（clarification），將「glass type（玻璃類型）」的說法統一為「glass performance（玻璃性能）」——強調測試結果是基於「性能表現」的分類，而非純粹的「化學成分」分類。這個細微差異對 Type II 玻璃特別重要：Type II 的「高性能」來自表面處理，而非玻璃本體組成。
blocks.en: The mark "▲ (IRA 1-Oct-2023)" that appears repeatedly in the text of this chapter denotes an Interim Revision Announcement, officially effective from 1 October 2023. These revisions are mainly textual clarifications that unify the wording "glass type" into "glass performance", emphasizing that test results classify glass by "performance" rather than purely by "chemical composition". This subtle difference is particularly important for Type II glass: the "high performance" of Type II comes from the surface treatment, not from the composition of the bulk glass.

blocks.zh: USP 〈660〉 完整測試架構總覽
blocks.en: Overview of the Complete USP <660> Test Structure

blocks.zh:
USP 〈660〉 測試架構總覽：

化學耐性測試（Chemical Resistance）
├── Glass Grains Test
│   ├── 適用：Type I, II, III
│   ├── 方法：粉末萃取，0.02M HCl 滴定
│   ├── 條件：121°C × 30 min
│   └── 限度：Table 4（Type I: 0.1; II/III: 0.85 mL/g）
│
├── Surface Glass Test
│   ├── 適用：Type I, II, III
│   ├── 方法：整體容器萃取，0.01M HCl 滴定
│   ├── 條件：121°C × 60 min
│   └── 限度：Table 6（依填充體積分級）
│
└── Surface Etching Test（選用/鑑別用）
    ├── 適用：Type I vs II 鑑別
    ├── 方法：HF/HCl 蝕刻 → Surface Glass Test
    └── 判讀：升高 5-10 倍 = Type II（表面處理）

雜質測試（Impurities）
└── Arsenic 〈211〉
    ├── 適用：Type I/II，水溶液注射劑
    ├── 樣品：Surface Glass Test 萃取液 35 mL
    └── 限度：≤0.1 µg/g

功能性測試（Functionality）
└── Spectral Transmission
    ├── 儀器：UV-Vis + 積分球
    ├── 範圍：290–450 nm
    ├── 非注射劑：≤10%（任何波長）
    └── 注射劑：依 Table 7（依容積與封口）
blocks.en:
Overview of the USP <660> test structure:

Chemical Resistance tests
├── Glass Grains Test
│   ├── Applies to: Type I, II, III
│   ├── Method: powder extraction, titration with 0.02M HCl
│   ├── Conditions: 121°C × 30 min
│   └── Limits: Table 4 (Type I: 0.1; II/III: 0.85 mL/g)
│
├── Surface Glass Test
│   ├── Applies to: Type I, II, III
│   ├── Method: whole-container extraction, titration with 0.01M HCl
│   ├── Conditions: 121°C × 60 min
│   └── Limits: Table 6 (graded by filling volume)
│
└── Surface Etching Test (optional / for differentiation)
    ├── Applies to: Type I vs II differentiation
    ├── Method: HF/HCl etching → Surface Glass Test
    └── Interpretation: 5-10 times increase = Type II (surface treated)

Impurities tests
└── Arsenic <211>
    ├── Applies to: Type I/II, aqueous injectables
    ├── Sample: 35 mL of Surface Glass Test extract
    └── Limit: ≤0.1 µg/g

Functionality tests
└── Spectral Transmission
    ├── Instrument: UV-Vis + integrating sphere
    ├── Range: 290–450 nm
    ├── Non-parenteral: ≤10% (at any wavelength)
    └── Parenteral: per Table 7 (by volume and closure)

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 客戶帶來一個 Type II 琥珀色玻璃瓶，裝填的是 pH 7.4 的蛋白質注射液（10 mL）。請列出依 USP 〈660〉 需要進行的所有測試項目，並說明各項測試的判定依據。
blocks.en: A CDMO client brings a Type II amber glass vial filled with a pH 7.4 protein injection (10 mL). List all the test items required under USP <660> and explain the acceptance basis for each.

blocks.zh: USP 將 〈660〉 的核心章節標題從「Glass Type」改為「Glass Performance」（IRA 2023），這個改變的背後邏輯是什麼？對 Type II 玻璃的品質控制有何影響？
blocks.en: USP changed the heading of the core section of <660> from "Glass Type" to "Glass Performance" (IRA 2023). What is the logic behind this change? What is its impact on quality control of Type II glass?

blocks.zh: 比較 USP 〈660〉 與 ICH Q3E 在玻璃容器評估方面的範疇差異：哪些風險是 〈660〉 可以覆蓋的，哪些需要額外的 E&L（extractables & leachables）研究？
blocks.en: Compare the difference in scope between USP <660> and ICH Q3E in the evaluation of glass containers: which risks can <660> cover, and which need additional E&L (extractables & leachables) studies?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 可萃取砷測試（Arsenic 〈211〉）：僅針對 Type I/II 水溶液注射劑容器，使用 Surface Glass Test 萃取液，限度 ≤ 0.1 µg/g，確保患者安全。
blocks.en: Extractable arsenic test (Arsenic <211>): only for Type I/II containers for aqueous injectable products, using the Surface Glass Test extract, limit ≤ 0.1 µg/g, to ensure patient safety.

blocks.zh: 有色玻璃光譜透射率測試：UV-Vis 分光光度計加積分球，測量 290–450 nm 範圍；非注射劑 ≤10%，注射劑依 Table 7（容積越大、蓋封型→限度更嚴）。
blocks.en: Spectral transmission test for colored glass: UV-Vis spectrophotometer with integrating sphere, measuring the 290–450 nm range; non-parenteral ≤10%, parenteral per Table 7 (larger volume, closure type → stricter limit).

blocks.zh: Table 7 雙重分層（容積×封口方式）設計，反映實際容器幾何形狀對光保護能力的影響。
blocks.en: The two-level design of Table 7 (volume × closure type) reflects the effect of actual container geometry on light protection capability.

blocks.zh: USP 〈660〉 是強制性規格標準；〈1660〉 提供補充指引（脫層、內表面耐久性）；兩者需結合使用才能完整評估現代生物製劑的玻璃容器風險。
blocks.en: USP <660> is a compulsory specification standard; <1660> provides supplementary guidance (delamination, inner surface durability); the two must be used together to fully evaluate the glass container risk of modern biologics.

blocks.zh: 整章三層架構（化學耐性→雜質安全→功能性保護）構成藥用玻璃容器的完整 USP 合規框架，是 CDMO 容器選材決策的核心依據。
blocks.en: The three-layer structure of the whole chapter (chemical resistance → impurity safety → functional protection) forms the complete USP compliance framework for pharmaceutical glass containers and is the core basis for CDMO container material selection decisions.
